G A M I N G

## PNY GEFORCE GTX™ 1660 Ti 6GB XLR8 Gaming Overclocked Edition

Best-In-Class Performance Best-in-class performance with the advanced graphics capabilities of the award-winning NVIDIA Turing architecture.

State-Of-The-Art-Graphics State-of-the-art graphics features, including variable rate shading, mesh shading, and multi-view rendering.

Turing Shaders Concurrent execution of floating point and integer operations, adaptive shading technology, and a new unified memory architecture enable awesome performance increases on today’s games.

#### PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS NVIDIA ® CUDA Cores 1536

GRAPHICS REINVENTED The GeForce® GTX 1660 Ti is built with the breakthrough graphics performance of the award-winning NVIDIA Turing™ architecture. With performance that rivals the GeForce GTX 1070, it’s a blazing-fast supercharger for today’s most popular games, and even faster with modern titles. GeForce GTX 1660 Ti graphics cards are advanced graphics cards designed to deliver a powerful combination of gaming innovation and next-gen graphics. Get game ready with performance that rivals the GeForce GTX 1070 on the latest games with the GeForce GTX 1660 Ti.
